name: Goliath
description: The most record-breaking roller coaster at Six Flags Great America — Goliath is a legendary RMC wooden coaster holding three world records as the tallest, fastest and steepest wooden coaster ever built, reaching 107 km/h down a 93-degree beyond-vertical drop. One of the most extraordinary and rerideable coasters at any Chicago-area theme park. Min 137cm.

name: Maxx Force
description: The fastest launch coaster in the world at Six Flags Great America — Maxx Force rockets riders from 0 to 193 km/h in just 1.8 seconds through a spectacular layout of extreme inversions. The most intense and technologically advanced coaster at any Six Flags park in the Midwest. Min 137cm.

name: Raging Bull
description: A spectacular and beloved hyper coaster at Six Flags Great America — Raging Bull is a magnificent B&M hyper coaster delivering extraordinary airtime over a breathtaking 58-metre first drop and a series of exhilarating speed hills and banked turns. One of the finest and most rerideable hyper coasters in the Midwest. Min 137cm.

name: Superman: Ultimate Flight
description: A spectacular flying coaster at Six Flags Great America placing riders in a prone flying position through a series of breathtaking swooping maneuvers and the legendary pretzel loop inversion. One of the most unique and exhilarating coaster experiences in the Chicago area. Min 137cm.

name: X Flight
description: A spectacular wing coaster at Six Flags Great America with seats extending far to each side of the track through a dramatic layout of dives, rolls and near-miss elements with structures and scenery. One of the most visually exciting wing coasters in the United States. Min 122cm.

name: Batman The Ride
description: A classic and beloved Batman-themed inverted coaster at Six Flags Great America delivering five inversions at 80 km/h through a spectacular themed layout. One of the most popular and rerideable inverted coasters in Illinois. Min 137cm.

name: American Eagle
description: A legendary and beloved racing dual-track wooden coaster at Six Flags Great America — American Eagle is a massive twin wooden coaster with a spectacular 55-metre first drop that has been thrilling Chicagoland visitors since 1981. One of the most iconic and historically significant wooden coasters in the United States. Min 107cm.

name: Viper
description: A classic and beloved looping coaster at Six Flags Great America delivering multiple inversions in a compact and exciting layout. One of the most charming and accessible thrill coasters in the Chicago area. Min 137cm.

name: Demon
description: A classic and beloved looping coaster at Six Flags Great America featuring double loops and corkscrews through a dramatic themed layout with fire and sound effects. A beloved Great America institution since 1980. Min 107cm.

name: The Joker
description: A spectacular free-fly coaster at Six Flags Great America where seats rotate independently as the train navigates a twisted layout of inversions. A uniquely disorienting and entertaining coaster experience. Min 122cm.

name: Whizzer
description: A beloved and charming classic speed coaster at Six Flags Great America — Whizzer is a uniquely smooth and enjoyable classic coaster that has been delighting families since 1976. One of only a few Arrow speed coasters still operating in the United States. Min 107cm.

name: Revolution
description: A classic and beloved giant loop coaster at Six Flags Great America — Revolution delivers a single massive loop with great speed and a classic coaster experience beloved by generations of Chicagoland families. Min 107cm.

name: The Dark Knight
description: A fun and popular indoor wild mouse coaster at Six Flags Great America themed to The Dark Knight — featuring unexpected turns, special effects and Batman-themed scenes in a completely enclosed indoor environment. Suitable for families. Min 107cm.

name: Splashwater Falls
description: A classic and refreshing log flume ride at Six Flags Great America splashing guests through a dramatic waterfall finale. One of the most popular and beloved water rides for families in the Chicago area. Min 107cm.

name: Condor
description: A spectacular giant swing ride at Six Flags Great America lifting riders high above the park for breathtaking panoramic views over the Chicago area. One of the most scenic and enjoyable flat rides at any Midwest theme park. Min 107cm.
